title.zh: Hyperliquid opens native lending as HYPE hits new ATH above $90
title.en: Hyperliquid opens native lending as HYPE hits new ATH above $90

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid launched native manual borrowing on HyperCore, allowing users to pledge HYPE or Bitcoin as collateral to borrow USDC or USDT, with $269 million borrowed on the first day as HYPE reached a new all-time high above $90.
